violation_type.title: Outdoor Activity Space Accessible By Safe Route (26 TAC §747.4113)
violation_type.short_title: Outdoor Activity Space Accessible By Safe Route
violation_type.typical_finding: It was observed that the route to the backyard is thru an enclosed area that served at storage room.  The following items are accessible to children when they walk through:  Hammer, Saw, various cleaning bottles, portable cooker.

finding_variants.text: It was observed that the route to the backyard is thru an enclosed area that served at storage room.  The following items are accessible to children when they walk through:  Hammer, Saw, various cleaning bottles, portable cooker.
The home is using an outdoor activity space that is not connected to the home and has not been approved by Licensing.
